package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

const migrationLedgerTable = "tz_schema_migration"

type Migration struct {
	Filename string
	SQL      string
	SHA256   string
}

type AppliedMigration struct {
	Filename  string
	SHA256    string
	AppliedAt time.Time
}

// LoadMigrations loads only ordered forward migrations. It intentionally
// excludes rollback SQL so every runtime uses the same forward-only path.
func LoadMigrations(directory string) ([]Migration, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migrations: %w", err)
	}
	filenames := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".up.sql") {
			continue
		}
		filenames = append(filenames, entry.Name())
	}
	sort.Strings(filenames)
	if len(filenames) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("no forward migrations found")
	}
	migrations := make([]Migration, 0, len(filenames))
	for _, filename := range filenames {
		payload, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, filename))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", filename, err)
		}
		digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
		migrations = append(migrations, Migration{
			Filename: filename,
			SQL:      string(payload),
			SHA256:   hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]),
		})
	}
	return migrations, nil
}

func ApplyMigrations(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn, migrations []Migration) error {
	if len(migrations) == 0 {
		return errors.New("no forward migrations supplied")
	}
	if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tz_schema_migration (
		filename text PRIMARY KEY,
		sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,
		applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
	)`); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create migration ledger: %w", err)
	}
	for _, migration := range migrations {
		if err := applyMigration(ctx, conn, migration); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func AppliedMigrations(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn) ([]AppliedMigration, error) {
	rows, err := conn.Query(ctx, `SELECT filename, sha256, applied_at FROM tz_schema_migration ORDER BY filename`)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migration ledger: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]AppliedMigration, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var migration AppliedMigration
		if err := rows.Scan(&migration.Filename, &migration.SHA256, &migration.AppliedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan migration ledger: %w", err)
		}
		result = append(result, migration)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("iterate migration ledger: %w", err)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func applyMigration(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn, migration Migration) error {
	tx, err := conn.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("begin migration %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('ms-go-tz-planner/migrations/v1'))`); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lock migration %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
	}
	var appliedDigest string
	err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT sha256 FROM tz_schema_migration WHERE filename = $1`, migration.Filename).Scan(&appliedDigest)
	if err == nil {
		if appliedDigest != migration.SHA256 {
			return fmt.Errorf("migration %s checksum differs from the recorded migration", migration.Filename)
		}
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit migration check %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return fmt.Errorf("read migration ledger for %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, migration.SQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("apply migration %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO tz_schema_migration (filename, sha256) VALUES ($1, $2)`, migration.Filename, migration.SHA256); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("record migration %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("commit migration %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
	}
	return nil
}
